about_the_game:
FOCUS GROUP - First Day is the free two-player puzzle prologue of FOCUS GROUP, a co-op puzzle adventure in the 1980s halls of Compliance Forge. You and your partner test prototypes under observation. Every room is a trial. Every success unlocks the next experiment.

  • Two player co-op: Every puzzle needs both players. You each get different tools or information and must work together to solve problems that neither of you could complete alone.

  • Communication is the key: When something goes wrong (and it will) you’ll need to stay calm, describe clearly, and think fast.

  • Story in a dystopian corporate world: Your only contact is Nora, your overly professional "personal coach." She's helpful. Maybe too helpful. And something about this place feels... wrong.

    Note: FOCUS GROUP - First Day is a co-op only game. It requires two players, each with an internet connection.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04, Ubuntu 18.04 or more recent
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver or AMD Vulkan drivers for the best experience. Also compatible with Mesa drivers.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04, Ubuntu 18.04 or more recent
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver or AMD Vulkan drivers for the best experience. Also compatible with Mesa drivers.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
